name: Peace
verse: A pink lotus blooms in the autumn pond,
a calm heart, a quiet home, blessings all around.
meaning: Peace and harmony fill your home.

name: Prosperity
verse: Spring brings fresh buds to every branch,
your work goes well and blessings come home.
meaning: Wealth flows in and your business thrives.

name: Good Health
verse: The full moon lights the eaves,
body and mind are strong, ancestors watch over you.
meaning: You enjoy good health and peace of body and mind.

name: All Wishes Granted
verse: A kind wind fills the distant sail,
what you seek you find, what you wish succeeds.
meaning: Everything goes as you wish.

name: A Flourishing Family
verse: A tall tree gives shade to all,
devoted children gather in love.
meaning: Your family is harmonious and your children devoted.

name: Success
verse: Steady steps on a long road,
your name shines like blossoms on the branch.
meaning: Your career rises and stands on firm ground.

name: Blessings and Fortune
verse: Golden clouds shelter the high sky,
blessings and fortune flow from every side.
meaning: Blessings and fortune together, with helpers at your side.

name: Joy
verse: The temple bell rings at dawn,
a light heart, a light step, no sorrow in sight.
meaning: Your heart is joyful and your worries fade away.

name: Love
verse: Two birds share one blossoming branch,
a good bond has come to stay day after day.
meaning: Love is fulfilled and you meet a kindred soul.

name: Noble Helper
verse: On a long road a friend walks with you,
with a helping hand, every hardship passes.
meaning: A noble helper appears and your troubles are resolved.

name: Smooth Sailing
verse: On a long, calm river the boat drifts on,
every task goes well and reaches its end.
meaning: Everything goes smoothly, like a boat with the wind.

name: Wisdom
verse: A meditation lamp glows through the night,
wisdom opens and the way home is bright.
meaning: Your mind is clear and your studies advance.

name: Misfortune Passes
verse: The rain clears and warm sun returns,
misfortune fades and peace surrounds you.
meaning: Trouble passes and bad luck melts away.

name: Long Life
verse: A green pine stands in the winter sky,
parents strong and well, living with their children.
meaning: Your parents and grandparents enjoy long life and good health.

name: Abundance
verse: Golden fields of ripe, fragrant rice,
a rich harvest and plenty for all.
meaning: Your work prospers and your home is abundant.

name: Purity
verse: The lotus rises unstained by mud,
a heart as clear as jade, waiting for nothing.
meaning: Your mind is pure and free of worldly worries.

name: Great Blessing
verse: Buddhas of the ten directions bear witness,
your merit is complete, peace for ten thousand years.
meaning: Great blessings, with the protection of the Buddhas.

name: Open Roads
verse: The red gate opens wide to welcome spring,
the road ahead is broad and every way is clear.
meaning: Your work flows freely and every door opens.

name: Fulfillment
verse: The full moon shines upon the lake,
your dreams fulfilled, your fortunes secure.
meaning: Your wishes come true and everything is complete.

name: Auspicious
verse: Kind clouds gather on the mountaintop,
good omens reach your door, all things made whole.
meaning: Good omens arrive and all things turn out well.
